description: Search gate denied valid agentgrep record searches, leaving lazy-harness Jcode edit/write hooks stricter than the tool set used by Jcode agents.
reproSteps: Run on-tool-execute-before payload for edit/write with recent_tool_calls containing agentgrep and args_preview pointing at .lazy-harness/decisions; expected allow and session cache creation, not force-gate deny.

description: Jcode lifecycle hooks emitted plain text, causing invalid hook decision JSON errors when response.completed or tool.execute.before produced gate output.
reproSteps: Trigger response.completed with a helper that returns STOP text; before fix Jcode logs invalid hook decision JSON, after fix hook stdout is valid JSON with inject/body. Trigger tool.execute.before deny; stdout must be valid JSON action=deny with reason.

description: Host sync manifest briefly copied framework ADR 0028 into host decisions, breaking host ADR contiguity checks because Medivance received only 0028 without 0001~0027.
reproSteps: Sync lazy-harness to Medivance with decisions/0028-progressive-knowledge-graph-backbone.md listed as Category A, then run .lazy-harness/bin/lazy test; before fix D03 reports missing ADR numbers 1~27, after fix framework ADR 0028 is not copied to host decisions and host lazy test passes.

description: Active lazy-harness TypeScript scripts could hide explicit any types when installed into Medivance because the host lint temporarily ignored .lazy-harness/**, allowing framework code quality regressions to escape app lint gates.
reproSteps: Run grep for explicit any in active lazy-harness scripts before the fix; host-pilot.ts reports records:any[] and entry as any casts. After the fix the grep returns no matches and framework self-test passes.

description: Search/read-debt gates could false-positive when Jcode omitted prior Read/agentgrep calls from lifecycle recent_tool_calls even though tool.execute.after had logged the evidence.
reproSteps: Create a correlated Context Delivery packet requiring read/search evidence, leave lifecycle recent_tool_calls empty, and add same-message/session Read or agentgrep rows to .jcode/hooks/tool-events.jsonl. Before fix the pre-action permit/audit still denied; after fix it accepts the logged evidence. Hardening fixtures also ensure different-message same-session and pre-packet logs do not satisfy the gate.

description: Search-debt context must not rely on automatic Context Delivery/relevant-record helper output, blind guessed-string queries, or tool-specific allowlists. The hook must force the LLM/searcher to follow lazy-harness, inspect actual stored record/file inventory first, then leave root-bound search/read evidence before action.
reproSteps: Trigger message.received for a host-dependent request. Before the fix the hook could surface Relevant/Context Delivery helper context, imply deterministic helper output was authoritative, or bias the agent toward guessed grep strings. After the fix it emits STOP. Harness-first lazy-harness search-debt, injects compact actual layer/file inventory and generated-index/graph pointers, journals direct-search debt, treats tool names as examples rather than a closed allowlist, and blocks action until root-bound harness-following inventory/search/read evidence exists.
